listing.title: Marketplace listing check
listing.problem: A seller uploads a photo and fills in the listing. When the two disagree, buyers return the item. Nobody can check every listing by hand.

contradicted_field.instructions: Which field of `listing` does this photo contradict?

criteria.listing.color: the photo shows a different colour than `listing.color`
criteria.listing.product_type: the photo shows a different kind of product than `listing.product_type`
criteria.none of these: the photo is consistent with the listing

color_matches.instructions: The product in the photo matches `listing.color`.

criteria.true: the product is the listed colour
criteria.false: the product is clearly a different colour from the listed one

type_matches.instructions: The photo shows the kind of product given in `listing.product_type`.

criteria.true: the product is that kind of product
criteria.false: it is clearly a different kind of product

returns.title: Return check
returns.problem: A customer sends back an item for a refund. Is it the product you shipped, or something else in the box?

same_item.instructions: The second photo shows the same product as the first photo.

criteria.true: the second photo shows the same product as the first photo
criteria.false: the second photo shows a different product

returned_colour.instructions: What is the main colour of the product in the second photo?

qc.title: Production-line QC
qc.problem: A camera photographs every part on the line. Rules-based vision breaks when parts vary, and a person cannot look at every photo.

has_fault.instructions: Given the reference part in the first image, does the part in the second image have a fault?

criteria.true: the part in the second image is damaged or defective
criteria.false: the part in the second image is as good as the reference

fault_type.instructions: What is wrong with the part in the second image?

archive.title: Archive record audit
archive.problem: Museums and photo archives hold millions of records typed by hand decades ago. Some are wrong and nobody knows which.

wrong_field.instructions: Which field of `record` does this photograph contradict?

criteria.record.subject: the animal is not the one recorded
criteria.record.medium: the medium is wrong (e.g. the photo is black and white)
criteria.record.setting: the scene is not the recorded setting
criteria.none: the record is consistent with the photo

subject_matches.instructions: The photograph shows the animal recorded in `record.subject`.

criteria.true: the animal in the photo is the recorded subject
criteria.false: it is clearly a different animal

audit.title: Before / after audit
audit.problem: Collections, rentals and stockrooms are photographed before and after. Spotting what moved between two photos is slow, tedious work.

checklist.subject: a museum specimen tray
checklist.all_items_still_there: yes, everything in the reference is still in the frame
checklist.colours_as_before: yes, every object keeps its colour

task.what_counts: treat the two photos as matching unless an item was added, removed, recoloured or hidden

what_changed.instructions: Image 1 is the reference, image 2 the target. Following `task.what_counts`, what changed?

field_to_update.instructions: Somebody must update `checklist` after image 2 was taken. Which field needs changing? Changes that `task.what_counts` says to ignore do not count.

criteria.checklist.all_items_still_there: image 2 shows that 'all items still there' no longer holds
criteria.checklist.no_new_items: image 2 shows that 'no new items' no longer holds
criteria.checklist.colours_as_before: image 2 shows that 'colours as before' no longer holds
criteria.none of these: every field still holds for image 2

ticket.title: Support ticket triage
ticket.problem: Every ticket needs an owner and a priority before anyone reads it properly. Keyword rules misroute; a chat model needs parsing.

ticket.body: We were billed 480 USD twice on 3 September for the same 12 seats. I have now written three times and the only reply was an automated one. Our finance close is on Wednesday and I need the duplicate reversed before then.

department.instructions: Which department should own this ticket?

criteria.billing: payments, invoices, refunds and subscription charges
criteria.technical_support: the product is broken, erroring or unavailable
criteria.sales: new seats, upgrades, quotes and renewals

urgent.instructions: This ticket needs a reply today.

criteria.true: money is at stake, work is blocked, or the customer has a deadline within days
criteria.false: it can wait for the normal queue

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the customer sound?
criteria: impatient: chasing a reply or repeating themselves
angry: threatening to escalate, churn or dispute the charge
